corrections_to_initial_hypothesis.implication: Do not research or confirm additional Product Facts for these four merely to unlock initial Recommendation admission; G3 admits them through LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY_ADMISSION.

excluded_nonlegacy.reason: Current candidate taxonomy classification is sunscreen; G2 initial-admission policy does not support sunscreen.

runtime_risk.rule: No FATION Subject registration may execute until the subject-registration reprocess path is registry-pinned or an equivalent exact-registry contract is verified.

frozen_architecture.legacy_projection_rule: Do not backfill products.category for FATION. products.category is a legacy Recommendation compatibility projection.
frozen_architecture.canonical_taxonomy_rule: The existing product_catalog_taxonomy_assignments row is the canonical classification lineage and remains shadow.
frozen_architecture.taxonomy_authority_rule: catalog-taxonomy-v1 shadow/shadow_only is not itself Recommendation admission authority.
frozen_architecture.category_bridge_rule: Recommendation category authority must be a separate product-scoped reviewed grant derived from the exact existing taxonomy assignment; it must not globally activate catalog-taxonomy-v1.
frozen_architecture.product_fact_rule: Catalog identity/taxonomy authority never creates Product Fact Subject or Fact authority automatically.
frozen_architecture.task_rule: Do not call GPT/TRUST task claim workers while the three FATION tasks are identity-blocked.
frozen_architecture.g2_rule: contains_active is the mandatory Product Fact input for supported treatment admission. active_concentration and recommended_use_frequency are optional PDA context and must not become artificial admission blockers.
frozen_architecture.cutover_rule: No Recommendation admission/runtime cutover occurs until Product Fact and category-authority lanes independently pass and an explicit final cutover gate is authorized.

staged_plan.name: SUBJECT_REGISTRATION_REPROCESS_CONTRACT
staged_plan.purpose: Harden the existing Admin Subject registration flow to reprocess TRUST with exact Registry v1 via process_catalog_trust_product_v3 (or an equivalently pinned verified contract).
exit: isolated runtime proves SUBJECT_CREATION_REQUIRED -> exact Subject -> three RESEARCH_PENDING tasks

staged_plan.name: FATION_SUBJECT_REGISTRATION
staged_plan.purpose: Run reviewed Subject identity preflight and explicit controlled registration for FATION only.

staged_plan.name: FATION_REQUIRED_FACT_RESEARCH
staged_plan.purpose: Research official/product-specific evidence after Subject identity exists.
staged_plan.rule: Optional context may improve exfoliation_load but missing optional context must remain uncertainty, not a synthetic admission blocker.

staged_plan.name: FATION_EVIDENCE_REVIEW_PREFLIGHT
staged_plan.purpose: Materialize admissible Evidence, prepare review, and run Product Fact confirmation preflight.

staged_plan.name: FATION_PRODUCT_FACT_CONFIRMATION
staged_plan.purpose: Separately authorize and confirm only evidence-supported FATION Product Facts.
staged_plan.condition: Recommendation category-authority bridge remains inactive, so Product Fact confirmation alone cannot cut FATION into G3.

staged_plan.name: FATION_CATEGORY_AUTHORITY_SHADOW
staged_plan.purpose: Introduce a Recommendation-specific product-scoped category-authority grant/read contract over the existing FATION shadow taxonomy assignment.
invariants: existing taxonomy assignment remains unchanged unless separately governed
G3 production decision still uses existing path
dual-read shadow must show FATION category=treatment without catalog-only Recommendation leak

staged_plan.name: FATION_INITIAL_ADMISSION_CUTOVER
staged_plan.purpose: Explicitly activate the reviewed nonlegacy category-authority read for FATION and validate G3/G2 end to end.
preconditions: no other nonlegacy product becomes grantable
forbidden: public activation beyond existing Recommendation runtime semantics

stop_conditions: FATION official/candidate identity no longer converges on exact product/presentation
reviewed Subject formulation identity is ambiguous
catalog-taxonomy-v1 is no longer shadow/shadow_only without a separately reviewed migration
any of the 164 legacy compatibility products changes admission mode
any non-target nonlegacy product becomes newly admitted
contains_active evidence is insufficient or below product_specific_primary
G2/G3 output differs for reasons other than the bounded FATION admission
